fields.why: Hospitalization rates are compared across three age groups (≥65, 18–64, <18) and three older-age bands, and severe outcomes are tested across the three older-age bands.
Age is the only SPD compared across 3+ groups; race/ethnicity appears only as untested Table composition, and period and vaccination status are not SPDs.

The ≥65 rate stated as nine and 16 times those of the two younger groups is per-group vs referent only; ICU/IMV/death 'did not differ among subgroups (p>0.05 for all)' under the stated chi-square is omnibus; rates ranked highest ≥85 and lowest 65–74 are side by side. The flag is a false alarm because the chi-square covers the sampled chart data, not the surveillance rates.
